title: moeb-tool-origin failed: Read and ToolSearch used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: External tools Read (to read the oversized start_run output redirected by the kernel) and ToolSearch (to load deferred tool schemas) were used without MissingMoebTool signals, causing the moeb-tool-origin criterion to fail. The moeb-tool-origin rubric always fails when external tools are used regardless of signal status.
proposed_resolution: Add a moeb tool for reading kernel-redirected oversized tool output files; clarify whether infrastructure schema-loading tools (ToolSearch) are exempt from moeb-tool-origin or add a moeb equivalent.
